mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that signal economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 2-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which precedes corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or interaction term regression coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruptions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced economic output and inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines during supply chain disruptions, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) serve as a leading indicator of economic expansion that boosts corporate investment and consumer confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC over 2-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Weak employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or interaction term regression coefficient is positive with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, GDP growth above 2.0% with deceleration (GDPC1) precedes stable corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 is above 2.0% but decelerating, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
